source_costs: Raw window construction and its complete checks are paid inside each method budget; no free batch029 proposals.
repair_neighborhood: Actual damage closure and donor slots; quota assignment proposal plus forward/reverse opened-aircraft cycles and disjoint owner pairs; same-coverage two-task beam layers use exact global DAG deltas.
bounded_scope: At most16 removed tasks per closure,2 rounds,4 beam states,finite insertion positions. Actual explored assignment families, closures, truncated tasks, full leaves and deadlines are saved; not all198 tasks or all positions exhausted.
adoption: Only full exact K/C/coverage/physics and strictly smaller frozen weighted key than the common strong input, verified and adopted before deadline. Worse genuine pooled seeds are exploration only.
control: DIRECT independently constructs all12 raw ownership maps when time permits, then uses own pooled rescue seeds and identical repair rules, true donor slots, resource constraints and total wall ceiling.
timing: 40seconds includes CSV/network/input check, raw seed construction, repair, full checks and saved phases/counterfactual. Imports, IPC and parent ledger writes excluded; finalization reserve1second.
evidence: All saved raw families/proposals, post snapshots, true damage metrics, actual donor quotas, same-coverage beam clocks and complete leaves receive independent replay.
interpretation: Single fixed seed and historical optimized input plus extra budget; this is not a fresh end-to-end fair algorithm comparison or evidence of far superiority. No seed replacement or score-conditioned retry.
